text:
Riya: Heads-up — PulseCare flagged a large dedicated invoice charge they believe is incorrect. They were on a 10k token/month commit but got billed $8,100 in burst fees.
Marcus: Share invoice link?
Riya: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/pc_inv_2026 — excerpt:
 - commit_10k  usage: 9,800  amount: $0
 - burst_overage  usage: 90k   amount: $8,100
PulseCare asserts first 50k of burst should have been covered by their reserved commit (they purchased an add-on commit window earlier this quarter).
Anya: I checked tenant config — they were enrolled in promo `dedicated_commit_rollup_v2` on 1770000000. That rollout changed how commit windows are matched when the account has a multi-window add-on. Looks like we matched the add-on window but not the primary monthly commit.
Sam: That sounds like a matching priority bug. If primary commit was skipped, they'd be charged at full burst rate.
billing-bot: Invoice generated: pc_inv_2026 total:$8,100 created:1770000200 customer:pulsecare
Anya: Quick calc — expected bill with correct attribution would be ~$1,200 (so credit ~ $6,900). I'll run a reconciliation script to confirm exact amounts across token buckets.
Marcus: OK we need triage plan: (1) manual credit + explanatory line item on invoice, (2) run scan for other tenants in `dedicated_commit_rollup_v2`, (3) hotfix to matching priority logic, (4) communicate to Sales + CS so they can notify customers.
Riya: CS asked if SLA credits are impacted — do we have any service degradation?
infra-ops: No service incident in window — capacity/latency logs normal. This is billing attribution only.
Sam: I'll open a hotfix PR for matcher priority and add a unit test for multi-window ordering. Will tag it to the experiment gate so we don't flip other accounts unintentionally.
Anya: I'll stage reconciliation results in #finance-recon and attach the corrected invoice lines.
Marcus: Approve one-time credit up to $7k. If final reconciliation differs, we'll adjust.
Riya: I'll draft the customer message waiting on credit posting. Thanks team — please update this thread when the credit posts and when scan is complete.
Sam: PR merged to canary, rolling patch now.
Anya: Scan complete — 3 other accounts affected, all low dollar amounts (<$1k each). I'll add them to the same credit run.
Riya: Credit posted for $6,900 on pc_inv_2026. Messaging sent. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
